method: 36 new synthetic sources, expected before execution; actual unchanged local parser; no model or mocked extraction.
limits: Purposive stress set, not a representative accuracy estimate.
No binary PDF/DOCX/image parsing; case 17 is text after hypothetical PDF extraction.
Title-anchor matching tolerates decoration; full semantic fidelity is not measured.
Expected dates and source order are checked; ambiguous sources require review.
